defects_found_by_running_it: admin_credit wrote a lone CREDIT with no counter-DEBIT, outside a transaction. 51 unbalanced postings on a Sandbox three hours old. The same defect RA-060 fixed on the consumer path, in the merchant twin twelve lines away.
a refund of an already-settled payment was accepted and drove a wallet to -98 000. Refundability is entitlement; nothing asked whether the funds were still there.
the gateway collapsed every core 4xx on the settlement path into 502 UPSTREAM_ERROR, so FEE_DESTINATION_KYB_NOT_APPROVED reached the caller as 'could not create settlement'.

the Integration Health surface derived a pricing category by substring-matching the merchant's own free-text label and reported a rate from it. Since no rule is keyed on a category, the lookup always failed and raised a settlement blocker for a rule that will never exist.
the blueprint pinned sqlx-cli 0.7.4 against a workspace locked to 0.8.6. The only sanctioned migration path could not build; the legacy one could.
the sanctioned migration could only ever run once per database: the role bootstrap's DROP ROLE failed on a grant left by the previous run.
migrating rotated the runtime role's password without updating the copy the services read, locking them out of the database it had just migrated.
every deploy silently reset the container restart policy to 'no'.
